premise: Little bubbles rise in the rock pool and Little Fish asks everyone who's making them, until he hears a giggle and finds Clam.
inspiration: The question-round of nursery tales (who killed… made safe: who's making the bubbles?), with the answer a giggle.

en-US.title: Bubbles in the Pool
en-US.text: {canvas:bubbles 0.6 14s} [curious] Bloop. Bloop. Bloop. Little bubbles were rising in the rock pool. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish {fish:face surprised} swam round and round. Who's making bubbles? {urchin:enter} Was it Urchin? {urchin:live} Urchin wiggled his spines. Not me! {seaweed:enter} Was it Seaweed? {seaweed:wobble} Seaweed swayed. Not me! {fish:face sad} [short pause] Then Little Fish heard a tiny giggle, right at the bottom. {clam:enter} {clam:live} Clam opened up… and closed with a snap, and up came a string of bubbles. {sfx:bubbles} Bloop, bloop! {fish:face happy} [laughs] It's you, Clam! {clam:face happy} Clam giggled again, and more bubbles came up. {fish:live} Little Fish wiggled his fins and chased them. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] And soon everyone was laughing, and everything was full of bubbles. {clam:pulse}

es-ES.title: Burbujas en la charca
es-ES.text: {canvas:bubbles 0.6 14s} [curious] Blup. Blup. Blup. Unas burbujitas subían por la charca. {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito {fish:face surprised} nadaba en círculos. ¿Quién hace burbujas? {urchin:enter} ¿Sería Erizo? {urchin:live} Erizo meneó sus pinchos. ¡Yo no! {seaweed:enter} ¿Sería Alga? {seaweed:wobble} Alga se meció. ¡Yo no! {fish:face sad} [short pause] Entonces Pececito oyó una risita, justo en el fondo. {clam:enter} {clam:live} Almeja se abrió… y se cerró de golpecito, y subió una ristra de burbujas. {sfx:bubbles} ¡Blup, blup! {fish:face happy} [laughs] ¡Eres tú, Almeja! {clam:face happy} Almeja se volvió a reír, y subieron más burbujas. {fish:live} Pececito meneó las aletas y las persiguió. {urchin:face happy} {seaweed:face happy} {canvas:bubbles 0.8 10s} [happily] Y al poco, todos se reían, y todo estaba lleno de burbujas. {clam:pulse}

bubbles.prompt: a playful string of bubbles rising and popping in a rock pool, bloop bloop
